style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Nature fable, a single anatomically accurate ant futilely pushes an enormous rooted oak trunk. Ant has distinct head, compact THORAX in middle, narrow petiole and oval ABDOMEN at rear. Exactly SIX legs, all rooted in the compact thorax: a pair of front legs contact bark and two pairs of rear legs brace on ground. Abdomen is completely leg-free, no human arms or hands, no facial human features. Two elbowed antennae on head. Side-on profile so the leg attachment structure is clearly readable. Small ant placed against enormous tree and roots, tree upright untouched and immovable. No other ants. Show humorous futile effort through braced body, tree vs ant scale. Landscape 3:2, graphite outlines soft watercolor and colored pencil on ivory paper, no readable text logos letters or watermarks.
alt: 一隻螞蟻用前足抵著巨大樹幹、其餘足撐住地面使勁推，大樹扎根在泥土裡，完全沒有搖動。
